summary: Iteration 11: Frontend smoke regression after large backend refactoring (server.py 2438→56 lines, split into core.py/models.py/routes/*). Tested all main user flows post-refactor with test_debug@test.de. All pages load, all key data-testids present, navigation works, login + remember-me works, recipes/import/mealplanner/shopping/staples/nutrition/groups/notifications all render correctly. No backend API errors observed (other than expected 403 on /api/admin/users for non-admin user — by design).
passed_tests: Auth page loads at /auth with email-input, password-input, remember-me-checkbox, submit-button testids
Login with test_debug@test.de / password123 successful → redirects to /dashboard with welcome toast
Remember-me checkbox: session_token cookie has expires ~90 days in future (verified expires - now ≈ 7,776,000s)
Dashboard renders with stats (Rezepte=2, Mahlzeiten=0, Bewertungen=0), Heute-Plan, Schnellaktionen, Top bewertet
Recipes page (/recipes): renders 2 recipe cards (recipe-card-* testids), search-input, category-filter, difficulty-filter, add-recipe-button, Importieren button
Recipe detail (/recipes/:id): loads with image, title, portions, ingredients sidebar
Recipe Import dialog: opens with import-tab-url and import-tab-clipboard tabs, supported sites listed (REWE, KitchenStories, Chefkoch, Lecker.de, Eat Smarter, Springlane)

MealPlanner (/meal-planner): full week grid renders with meal-slot-{date}-{meal} testids for breakfast/lunch (×7 days), apply-template-btn, save-template-btn, copy-week-btn, save-plan-button, prev-week-button, next-week-button
ShoppingList (/shopping-list): renders week selector, progress bar, staple items section with staple-shopping-item-* testids
Staple Items (/staple-items): renders add-staple-item-btn, category filters, category-group-* sections, staple-item-* with toggle/edit/delete testids
Nutrition (/nutrition): renders with h1 'Nährwerte' and nutrition-tracking testid
Groups (/group): renders 'Gruppe erstellen' empty state with create-group-button
Notifications (/notifications): renders notification-settings-page with notification-status-card and subscribe-btn (push blocked in headless — expected)
User menu button (data-testid=user-menu-button) opens dropdown with 'Abmelden' link visible
Sidebar nav links present for all sections (nav-dashboard, nav-recipes, nav-ingredient-search, nav-meal-planner, nav-shopping-list, nav-staple-items, nav-nutrition, nav-group, nav-notifications)
No console errors (other than expected /api/admin/users 403 for non-admin user — Layout.jsx uses this to determine admin visibility)
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx admin-detection via /api/admin/users 403 produces noisy console errors for every non-admin user on every navigation; consider switching to /api/auth/me with is_admin field or a dedicated /api/admin/check endpoint to avoid 8+ 403s per session in DevTools console.

Backend refactoring from server.py (2438→56 lines) into core.py + models.py + routes/{auth,recipes,mealplans,shopping,groups,notifications,admin}.py looks clean from frontend perspective — all API contracts unchanged, no breakage observed.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing 2 recipes (Spaghetti Carbonara, Grüner Salat) and 2 staple items (Mineralwasser, Küchentücher).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend regression after big backend refactor PASSED. All routes tested: /dashboard, /recipes, /recipes/:id, /meal-planner, /shopping-list, /staple-items, /nutrition, /group, /notifications. All testids stable. Remember-me 90-day cookie verified. Import dialog has both URL and clipboard tabs. Push notifications blocked in headless browser (expected). Admin tests skipped (info@richardachatz.de account password not in test_credentials.md, only iteration_10 had it).
